restaurants.name: Nakano-ya (Hegi-soba)
restaurants.notes: Long-standing specialist in Niigata's signature hegi-soba (buckwheat noodles bound with funori seaweed). Walking distance from Echigo-Yuzawa Station.

restaurants.name: Uosanu
restaurants.notes: Traditional Niigata restaurant featuring Japan Sea seafood, mountain vegetables and Koshihikari rice. Counter and tatami seating.

restaurants.name: Yatsuko Sushi
restaurants.notes: Counter sushi with daily-changing neta sourced from the Japan Sea. Reservations strongly recommended.

restaurants.name: Ramen Tomokichi
restaurants.notes: Local shoyu and miso ramen shop popular with day-trippers and skiers. Walk-in only.

restaurants.name: Naeba Tavern
restaurants.address: 202 Mikuni, Yuzawa-machi, Minamiuonuma-gun, Niigata 949-6212 (Naeba Prince complex)
restaurants.notes: Western pub at the Naeba Prince base. Burgers, pizza, draught beer; busy après-ski with live music in peak weeks.

restaurants.name: Cafe Tsuruya
restaurants.notes: Café inside the CoCoLo Yuzawa station building. Local pastries, coffee and Niigata rice bowls — quick stop pre-/post-shinkansen.
